ES File Explorer - A Short Story of A Fallen King

I just updated a few apps today and got a big "your device needs cleaning" type ad in my notification drawer. That's unusual for me, since I'm pretty picky about my apps and don't see those on my phone often. A press and hold on the notification revealed ES File Explorer to be the culprit. I've been using it for a while and I've seen the feature bloat start to creep in but I don't use it often enough to worry about it. But now I'm looking for alternatives as well because it's gotten away from the simple file management I've relied on for so long.

Crap, I noticed this recently. The "clean your data" pop-ups and so on.

I noticed it was getting more "clean" and streamlined. It worried me, because this is the same route firefox is taking.

Yeah, I don't mind an attractive UI, but the feature bloat is what puts me off. I didn't realize it until I was digging into the settings looking for a way to turn off the nag notification, but there's a lot of features that have crept in that I don't even use:

  • News, Weather, Facebook (?!), Movies, APP, Music, Images, and Google all appear to be no more than web links that open in an internal browser. Who needs these when I can do all of those with other apps or my own browser of choice? And why do they have the top spot in the settings slider?
  • Links to common folders and locations - these I actually use and expect in a file browser for convenience
  • System manager, SD Card Analyst, Music Player, Hide List, Cleaner, and Gestures are all things I can do without

I feel like in the rush to cram more value into their app, they've strayed from the simplicity and ease of use that drew me to it in the first place. It's a shame because I like the UI (aside from the extra clutter) and literally the only thing for me to continue using the app would be to not mess with it. I liked it just fine. But now I'm looking for less noisy alternatives for file management.
